features.name: Interactive Card Builder / Editor (/card/create/form)
features.description: Full production-matched card editor at /card/create/form?template=:id. Left column: live interactive phone preview of the actual wedding card. Right column: 23 collapsible form sections (Giao diện → Ảnh thu nhỏ chia sẻ URL). Features: accordion section toggle, live name/color binding to phone preview, 9-item opening effect grid with inline card preview, drag-and-drop section reorder, URL share modal, BGM upload, theme picker modal, 5 floating quick-jump pencil buttons, Lưu thiệp PUT /cards/:id with save banner. Implemented in apps/web/src/card-editor-view.js (104KB), apps/web/src/server.js route /card/create/form, apps/web/public/app-client.js initCardEditor() (~500 lines).
features.evidence: Verified by npm run check (exit 0), npm test (100/100), and browser scenario (14 steps): editor loads at http://localhost:3000/card/create/form?template=bmmd8nf8vm1i, all 23 form sections present in DOM, Lưu thiệp PUT /cards/bmmd8nf8vm1i returns 200, save banner '✓ Đã lưu toàn bộ thay đổi' appears. HTML renders 37 matches for card-editor-root/edit-form-list/section-form. Screenshots: local_editor_1 through local_editor_14 in artifact directory.
